Resolves #20256

`Neo.grid.Container#createColumns()` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:993-1018`) now resolves `columnClass = column.module || me.constructor.columnTypes[column.type || 'column']` so a column config can name an external column class (from an app or component package) via `module` without subclassing `GridContainer` to redeclare `static columnTypes`, strips `module` from `buttonConfig` beside `id` so `Neo.grid.header.Toolbar` still creates a `Neo.grid.header.Button`, and deletes `column.module` beside `column.type` before `Neo.create`.

Evidence: L2 (Playwright unit suite in `test/playwright/unit/grid/`) → L2 required (all 5 close-target ACs).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Verification |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/DynamicColumn.spec.mjs` (`Column config module creates external column class, keeps HeaderButton, wins over type, and survives runtime columns replacement (#20256)` — verifies `{module: MyColumn, dataField: 'name'}` creates `MyColumn` absent from `GridContainer.columnTypes`) |
| AC-2 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/DynamicColumn.spec.mjs` (verifies `btn0` and `btn1` are `Neo.grid.header.Button` instances and not `MyColumn`) |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/DynamicColumn.spec.mjs` (`col2` with `type: 'index'` and `{dataField: 'name'}` default to `columnTypes` lookup; all 354 grid unit specs pass) |
| AC-4 | `test/playwright/unit/grid/DynamicColumn.spec.mjs` (reassigning `moduleGrid.columns = [{module: MyColumn, ...}, ...]` at runtime creates a new `MyColumn` and `HeaderButton`) |
| AC-5 | CI `unit` job + `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/grid/` (`354 passed (6.0s)`) |

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** ticket #20256, which is my own; I re-checked its cites at `dev` `3e908f05c8` rather than trusting them. Also `createColumns()` and `columnTypes` in `src/grid/Container.mjs`, the precedent for the trap (`src/container/Base.mjs` drops the `ntype` default when an item carries `module`), the header toolbar's `itemDefaults` (`src/grid/header/Toolbar.mjs`), and the sibling `module` uses (container items, `body: {module}`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** `module` resolves before the `columnTypes` lookup and never reaches the header button's config. Otherwise the toolbar drops its `ntype` default and builds the column class as the button. `columnTypes` stays as it is, with no registration API. Tests should use a spec-local column class that isn't in `columnTypes`, and destroy what they create.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches. At the head, `createColumns()` deletes `module` from `buttonConfig` beside `id`, resolves `columnClass = column.module || columnTypes[column.type || 'column']`, and deletes `module` from the column config beside `type`. JSDoc on `columns_` and `columnTypes` names both routes.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with friction → gold. An external package hit the seam; it was filed generically and fixed in the engine for every consumer instead of being worked around per grid.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: my ticket prescribed deleting `module` from the column config, as `type` already is. If configs weren't cloned upstream, that delete would strip `module` from a subclass's shared static `columns` and from configs an app sets again, and the next grid would silently get a plain column. Your spec re-sets with fresh objects, so I ran both shapes at `339b16657b` in a scratch spec:
  - two instances of one subclass whose static `columns` holds `{module: MyColumn}` and `{type: 'index'}` both resolve `MyColumn` and `Index`;
  - setting the same config objects twice keeps `MyColumn`, and the caller's objects still carry `module` afterwards.

  The delete is safe because the config system clones first, which is worth knowing if that cloning ever changes. Also non-blocking: nothing checks that `module` extends `Neo.grid.column.Base`. That's consistent with container items, which don't check `module` either.
